question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

72 - 33 × 605 ÷ 110 + 70 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given : 72 - 33 × 605 ÷ 110 + 70 = ?

According to the question, after replacing the signs :

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘-’ are interchanged
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged

So,​​

72 + **33 ÷ 605**__ × 110 - 70 = ?

72 + __0.054____** × 110**__ - 70 = ?

__**72 + 6**__ - 70 = ?

__**78 - 70**__ = ?

**8 = ?**

Hence, "8" is the correct answer.

7a
